nodes.summary: If `G` acts isometrically on `X` and every generator `P.val i` moves `x₀` by at most `M`, then `d(x₀, g • x₀) ≤ M |g|_P` for every `g`.
nodes.title: Orbit maps are Lipschitz for the word length

nodes.summary: For an isometric action, `d(g • x, h • x) = d(x, g⁻¹ h • x)`.
nodes.title: Distance between orbit points

nodes.summary: Let `X` be geodesic, `R ≥ 0` a covering radius for the orbit of `x₀`, and `S = {s | d(x₀, s • x₀) ≤ 2R + 1}`. Let `Q : G → ℕ → Prop` hold for `(s, 1)` with `s ∈ S` and be preserved by right multiplication by elements of `S` while increasing `m` by one. If `d(x₀, y) ≤ n` and `d(h • x₀, y) ≤ R`, then `Q h m` for some `m ≤ n + 1`.
nodes.title: Walking along a geodesic

nodes.summary: If every `G`-orbit meets the compact set `K`, there is `R ≥ 0` such that every point of `X` is within `R` of the orbit of `x₀`.
nodes.title: Cocompactness gives a covering radius

nodes.summary: Let a group $G$ act on a proper geodesic metric space $X$ by isometries, properly discontinuously and cocompactly, and let $x_0 \in X$. Then $G$ is generated by the finite set $S = \{g : d(x_0, g x_0) \le 2R + 1\}$, where $R$ is such that every point of $X$ is within $R$ of the orbit of $x_0$, and with $L = 2R + 1$, $C = R + 2$, and every point of $X$ is within $C$ of the orbit. The orbit map $g \mapsto g x_0$ is…
nodes.title: The Švarc–Milnor lemma

nodes.summary: For two finite generating families $P$ and $Q$ of a group $G$ there is an integer $K \ge 1$ with $|g|_P \le K |g|_Q$ and $|g|_Q \le K |g|_P$ for every $g \in G$. Since the word metric is $d(g, h) = |g^{-1} h|$, the identity of $G$ is a $K$-bi-Lipschitz map between the two word metrics. One can take for $K$ the largest length of a generator of one family written in the other.
nodes.title: Change of finite generating set is bi-Lipschitz

nodes.summary: If `φ : G →* H`, `Q` is a finite generating family of `G` and `P` any generating family of `H`, there is `K : ℕ` with `|φ g|_P ≤ K |g|_Q` for every `g : G` (Gromov, *Asymptotic invariants of infinite groups*, 1993, §0.2.C: "every homomorphism between finitely generated groups is Lipschitz").
nodes.title: Homomorphisms are Lipschitz for word lengths

nodes.summary: If `Q` is a finite generating family, there is `K : ℕ` with `|g|_P ≤ K |g|_Q` for every `g : G` (Gromov, *Groups of polynomial growth and expanding maps*, Publ. Math. IHÉS 53 (1981), p. 53).
nodes.title: Word lengths of two generating families are comparable

nodes.summary: A group acting by isometries, properly discontinuously and cocompactly on a nonempty proper geodesic metric space is finitely generated. Nonemptiness matters: every group acts on the empty space, and the empty compact set meets every orbit vacuously.
nodes.title: Švarc–Milnor: finite generation

nodes.summary: The generating family of `Multiplicative ℤ` consisting of the single element `ofAdd 1`.
nodes.title: The standard generator of the infinite cyclic group

nodes.summary: Under the hypotheses of the Švarc–Milnor lemma there is a finite generating family $P$ of $G$ such that the orbit map $g \mapsto g x_0$ is a quasi-isometry (`Metric.IsQuasiIsometry`) from $G$ with the word metric `P.normedGroup`, whose distance is $d(g, h) = |g^{-1} h|_P$, to $X$. nodes.title: Švarc–Milnor as a quasi-isometry

nodes.summary: With respect to the generator `ofAdd 1`, the word length of `ofAdd n` in `Multiplicative ℤ` is `|n|`.
nodes.title: Word length in the infinite cyclic group

nodes.summary: If `φ : G →* H` sends every generator `Q.val k` to an element of `P`-length at most `K`, then `φ` of the element represented by a `Q`-word `l` has `P`-length at most `K * l.length`.
nodes.title: Images of words under a homomorphism

nodes.summary: If every generator `Q.val k` has `P`-length at most `K`, then the element represented by a `Q`-word `l` has `P`-length at most `K * l.length`.
nodes.title: Rewriting a word in another generating family
